description: Triages all inbound leads from a given period — demo requests, free trial signups, content downloads, webinar registrations, chatbot conversations. Classifies by urgency, qualifies against ICP, enriches with context, and produces a prioritized action queue with recommended response for each lead. Tool-agnostic — works with any CRM, form tool, or lead source.
